caption:
Somewhere on your drive is a folder of receipts and intake forms you keep meaning to sort. Claude Cowork can go through it without you opening each file one at a time.

Cowork is Anthropic's desktop agent — you describe an outcome, step away, and come back to a finished spreadsheet. It's included with Claude Pro and up, not the free plan, and it now runs on both Mac and Windows.

It's not free of limits: long jobs burn through your usage fast, and it won't touch banking or single sign-on logins unless you add them yourself. Save this for the next time paperwork piles up.

Follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.

slides.headline: Point it at the whole folder.

body.t: Give Cowork access to a Drive or local folder instead of uploading files one at a time. It can open each receipt or intake form, pull the numbers, and build a spreadsheet from all of them in one pass.

slides.headline: Hand it the batch job.
slides.sub: Point it at a folder and give the instruction once.
slides.label: COPY THIS PROMPT
slides.code:
Open every file in this folder.
For each receipt: vendor, date, amount.
Build one spreadsheet, one row per
receipt, sorted by date.
Flag anything missing a total.
Save it back to the same folder.

body.t: — this isn't flat-rate. It also won't log into banking or single sign-on sites unless you add them yourself, one at a time.
